1445-4871-8227-8347.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-8227-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

907-2645-3430-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-2645-3430-4348.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4927-5078-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-6559.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2869-3184-3200.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by sacrificing it.
Yomiji triggers due to Leyline of Singularity, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Urza's Bauble's ability.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1169-2033-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1169-2033-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1169-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-2457-3129-5434.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

874-1170-1329-4742.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-4742.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2921-5170-6132-7286.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3557-7150.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken creature.
3557-7150.description:
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Brago's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Brago's trigger, blinking Kirol, the other creature and any other desired permanents.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Earth Kingdom General

1409-2060-4017-7085.description:
Activate Earth Kingdom General by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Earth Kingdom General.
Resolve the Earth Kingdom General trigger, causing you to earthbend a land, thus putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Earth Kingdom General's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2893-3875-4500-4826.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

1268-1336.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.

57-647-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-647-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5344-6349-6884.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5344-6349-6884.description:
Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, exiling Charismatic Conqueror.
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from exile by paying {2}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 9.

2919-3490-3641-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-3641-4050.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2478-6633.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1563-2351-6460-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-6460-6633.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

880-4871-6528.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4871-6528.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4050-4675-6511.manaNeeded: {7}{W}{W}{B}{B} minus {W/B} for each nontoken Knight you control
4050-4675-6511.notablePrerequisites: There are at least 11 Knights between nontoken creatures you control and cards in your graveyard.
4050-4675-6511.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing each Knight you control, adding {W/B} for each Knight.
When you sacrifice Cavalier of Dawn, its second ability triggers, returning Knights' Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Knights' Charge by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Activate Knights' Charge by paying {6}{W}{B} and sacrificing it, returning all Knights from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2018-5686-6288.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

645-914-3750-5686.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-3750-5686.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-4050-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cats, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

5641-5783-5785.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that has flying due to Combine Chrysalis.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.
You may sacrifice the Eldrazi Spawns to get infinite {C}, if desired.

1874-2919-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
1874-2919-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

337-4222-4452-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Rukarumel.
337-4222-4452-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

719-2457-4434-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
"Treefolk" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2457-4434-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
When the Insect enters the battlefield as a Treefolk due to Xenograft, Quickbeam triggers, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1887-4050-4080-4577.notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least three reprieve counters.
1887-4050-4080-4577.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Huatli's Raptor, adding one mana of any color.
Huatli's Raptor dies, triggering Magnanimous Magistrate, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Huatli's Raptor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Huatli's Raptor enters the battlefield, causing you to proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

1074-1175-1651-2466.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's other ability by tapping King Macar, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Pay {1} and tap Patriar's Seal to activate it's last ability, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating a Gold token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Gold token and Honor-Worn Shaku, untapping Patriar's Seal.
Activate the tapped Gold token by sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2 until all opponent' creatures are exiled.
Repeat from step 2 whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2267-3054-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2267-3054-4050.description:
Sacrifice Oathsworn Vampire for {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard.
Tormod triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie token.
Sacrifice the Zombie token for {B}.
Repeat.
